items.source: If custom supported types have been configured, the default implementation creates a Yaml instance that filters out unsupported types encountered in YAML documents. If an unsupported type is encountered, a ComposerException will be thrown when the node is processed.
items.translation: 如果已配置自定义支持类型，默认实现会创建一个Yaml实例，以过滤 YAML 文档中遇到的不支持的类型。如果遇到不支持的类型，在处理该节点时将抛出ComposerException。

items.source: If no supported types are configured, only Java standard classes (as defined in SafeConstructor) encountered in YAML documents will be supported. If an unsupported type is encountered, a ComposerException will be thrown when the corresponding YAML node is processed.
items.translation: 如果未配置任何支持的类型，则仅支持在 YAML 文档中遇到的 Java 标准类（如SafeConstructor中所定义）。如果遇到不支持的类型，则在处理相应的 YAML 节点时将抛出ComposerException。

items.source: The default implementation sets the "allowDuplicateKeys" flag to false, enabling built-in duplicate key handling.
items.translation: 默认实现将 `"allowDuplicateKeys"` 标志设置为 `false`，从而启用内置的重复键处理。

items.source:
A map of document matchers allowing callers to selectively use only some of the documents in a YAML resource. In YAML documents are separated by --- lines, and each document is converted to properties before the match is made. For example, 
environment: dev
url: https://dev.bar.com
name: Developer Setup
---
environment: prod
url:https://foo.bar.com
name: My Cool App
when mapped with 
setDocumentMatchers(properties ->
    ("prod".equals(properties.getProperty("environment")) ? MatchStatus.FOUND : MatchStatus.NOT_FOUND));
would end up as 
environment=prod
url=https://foo.bar.com
name=My Cool App
items.translation:
一个文档匹配器映射，允许调用者选择性地使用 YAML 资源中的部分文档。在 YAML 中，文档由 `---` 行分隔，每个文档在匹配之前会被转换为属性。例如， 
environment: dev
url: https://dev.bar.com
name: Developer Setup
---
environment: prod
url=https://foo.bar.com
name: My Cool App
当与以下代码配合使用时： 
setDocumentMatchers(properties ->
    ("prod".equals(properties.getProperty("environment")) ? MatchStatus.FOUND : MatchStatus.NOT_FOUND));
最终结果将是： 
environment=prod
url=https://foo.bar.com
name=My Cool App

items.source: Provide an opportunity for subclasses to process the Yaml parsed from the supplied resources. Each resource is parsed in turn and the documents inside checked against the matchers. If a document matches it is passed into the callback, along with its representation as Properties. Depending on the setResolutionMethod(ResolutionMethod) not all the documents will be parsed.
items.translation: 为子类提供处理从提供的资源中解析的 Yaml 的机会。每个资源依次进行解析，并检查其中的文档是否符合 `matchers`。如果文档匹配，则将其传递给回调函数，同时附带其作为 Properties 的表示形式。根据 `setResolutionMethod(ResolutionMethod)`，并非所有文档都会被解析。

items.source: Return a flattened version of the given map, recursively following any nested Map or Collection values. Entries from the resulting map retain the same order as the source. When called with the Map from a YamlProcessor.MatchCallback the result will contain the same values as the YamlProcessor.MatchCallback Properties.
items.translation: 递归展平给定的 Map，并遵循任何嵌套的 Map 或 Collection 值。结果 Map 中的条目保持与源相同的顺序。当调用自 YamlProcessor.MatchCallback 的 Map 时，结果将包含与 YamlProcessor.MatchCallback Properties 相同的值。

items.source: Flag indicating that a document for which all the document matchers abstain will nevertheless match. Default is true.
items.translation: 标记指示即使所有 `文档匹配器` 都放弃，该文档仍然会匹配。默认值为 `true`。

items.source: Method to use for resolving resources. Each resource will be converted to a Map, so this property is used to decide which map entries to keep in the final output from this factory. Default is YamlProcessor.ResolutionMethod.OVERRIDE.
items.translation: 用于解析资源的解决方法。每个资源都将转换为 Map，因此此属性用于决定从该工厂保留哪些 map 条目作为最终输出。默认值为 YamlProcessor.ResolutionMethod.OVERRIDE。
